I have seen some reviews that mention a calendar glitch. I haven’t experienced that yet, but I believe that even with such a glitch, I would continue using the app because it is so good in every other way! That being said, I encourage the DEVs to keep improving it because this has the potential to be HUGE if all the little bugs can be worked out. title: Such a good app (with slight issues)
body: Let me just start by saying I absolutely love this app. I wanted a simple habit tracker to keep track of my daily routine to stay on track and motivate myself. Very simple to use, and the interface is very clean and nice. My only MAJOR issue I have with this app is that the calendar is off. I used it for months with no problem, but once it hit January 31st, it didn’t show the date on the calendar. It cut off January at 30th. I’ve noticed at the end of every month the days are off by one day. An example is that February 28th shows as a Saturday on the app, but it’s actually a Friday. I hope they fix this soon because I really love this app!!

title: The ONLY habit tracker I like!
body: I went through a few habit tracking apps over the course of January, and the interface and options just didn’t strike me. But this one has me coming back to it every day to update my habits! The checking off is satisfying, the UI actually makes sense and shows me my checklist for the day, and I love that I can select which days of the week I want to do certain goals!! To top it off, it’s absolutely free! No subscriptions, no pestering me about upgrading to a “pro” version, no ads. It is *chefs kiss*! Thanks to the creators because this has actually made me stick to my goals!
